mapper.select: SELECT ci.id, ci.order_id as orderId, bo.order_no as orderNo, r.room_number as roomNumber, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, ci.check_in_time as checkInTime, ci.check_out_time as checkOutTime, bo.days, NVL(cos.total_fee, 0) as totalAmount FROM check_in_record ci LEFT JOIN booking_order bo ON ci.order_id = bo.id LEFT JOIN room r ON ci.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON r.room_type_id = rt.id LEFT JOIN check_out_settlement cos ON ci.id = cos.check_in_id WHERE ci.guest_id_card = #{guestIdCard} ORDER BY ci.check_in_time DESC
